propositions: Snapshot janitor runs only in the review-bot process; non-review-bot hosts (developer laptops, CI runners, libraries) populate the snapshot store append-only with no reclamation mechanism

The operation-linked GC trigger must avoid holding ticket-store locks or enumerating the store (O(1) on quiet path), using a detached child pattern mirroring compact_trigger to keep work off hot paths
The trigger is keyed on the per-host snapshot store root (gc/last-pass.stamp and gc/worker.lock sidecars) so all worktrees share one clock and lock
A gate resolution on a due/missing stamp spawns a detached run_gc child; overlap with the review-bot's resident janitor is harmless (both use the same flock and stand-aside gracefully)
The detached child runs with a durable cwd anchored at the store root, stamped worker.lock for single-flight adjudication, and never raises into the triggering gate
